description: Find a creator by NAME or @handle — ranked FOOTPRINT candidates (each is one cross-platform creator with their identity_group_id, linked platforms, score + recency) from CreatorScore's index. FREE (0 credits): index lookup only, no scraping and no web search. If they are NOT in our index, you can set search_web:true to also search the web for them — that costs 1 credit, so only do it after the user agrees to spend it. A CreatorScore is always the whole footprint; nothing is auto-attributed — confirm the right person, then score/compare them. After picking, read their unified score with vet_creator or build/refresh it with score_creator_footprint.

search_web.description: Also search the WEB when our index has no strong match. Costs 1 credit. Default false (free, index-only). Only set true after the user explicitly agrees.

name: find_creator
